REPORT zcv_fs_scope.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_upload,
         id TYPE i,
       END OF ty_upload.

DATA gt_upload TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_upload WITH DEFAULT KEY.
DATA gt_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY.
DATA gv_answer TYPE c LENGTH 1.

FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_upload> TYPE ty_upload.

* Bound here, used in show: the class keeps the binding.
FORM pick.
  READ TABLE gt_upload INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_upload>.
ENDFORM.

FORM show.
  IF <ls_upload> IS ASSIGNED.
    WRITE / <ls_upload>-id.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

* The FORM's own <ls_upload> hides the global one.
FORM copy_data.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_upload> LIKE LINE OF gt_upload.
  LOOP AT gt_ids ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_id>).
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO gt_upload ASSIGNING <ls_upload>.
    <ls_upload>-id = <lv_id>.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.

* The rest of the FORM after the popup runs in the resume method.
FORM confirm_copy.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_row> LIKE LINE OF gt_upload.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      text_question = 'Copy?'
    IMPORTING
      answer        = gv_answer.
  IF gv_answer = '1'.
    READ TABLE gt_upload INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_row>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <ls_row>-id = <ls_row>-id + 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  APPEND 1 TO gt_ids.
  PERFORM copy_data.
  PERFORM pick.
  PERFORM show.
  PERFORM confirm_copy.
